- [Model fallbacks](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/llm-gateway-fallbacks.md): A fallback chain has: - **A primary model**: the provider and model that trigger the chain when a request fails.
- [Per-customer policies](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/llm-gateway-header-policies.md): The gateway matches on request headers prefixed with `X-Gateway-`, and on keys inside the `X-Gateway-Metadata` JSON header. No other request header is matchable.
- [Monitor LLM Gateway spend](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/llm-gateway-monitoring.md): The LLM Gateway **Spend Monitoring** dashboard shows how much LLM cost a [workspace](/langsmith/administration-overview#workspaces) has accrued through the gateway.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/llm-gateway-quickstart.md): The LLM Gateway lets you call models across configured providers through one standard endpoint with one LangSmith API key.
- [Rate limit policies](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/llm-gateway-rate-limit-policies.md): Rate limit policies are evaluated for every incoming request.
- [Spend policies](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/llm-gateway-spend-policies.md): Spend policies are evaluated from broadest to most specific. All matching policies are checked, and if any one returns a block, the request is rejected.
